summary: Bail grant challenged; distinction between setting aside vs. cancellation of bail; High Court order granting bail set aside due to seriousness of offence, role of accused, and risk of undermining justice; prima facie evidence of impersonation in public examination; financial transaction via Rs.10 lakh cheque recovered; criminal conspiracy under IPC and Rajasthan Public Examination Act; bail denied by trial court, reversed by High Court, now restored by Supreme Court.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.419, s.420, s.467, s.468, s.120B
Rajasthan Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2022 s.3, s.10
Ansar Ahmad v. State of U.P.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned bail order set aside; respondents not entitled to bail at this stage; custody reinstated pending trial.
